entries.description: Dynamic Time-of-Day Atmosphere System — the 3D scene subtly shifts its ambient atmosphere based on visitor's local time with warm golden dawn, bright midday, rich sunset tones, or deep night. Background, lights, stars, moon, waves, and flower colors all respond to time-of-day with smooth interpolation between phases.
changes: Added time-of-day calculation system with dawn/morning/midday/sunset/evening/night phases
Defined time-based presets for lighting, colors, and atmospheric properties
Updated ambient, directional, and point lights to change based on time of day
Modified Van Gogh shader uniforms to respond to time-of-day
Updated wave shader colors based on time of day
Added time-based background color interpolation for desktop (mobile preserves original logic)
Preserved all existing features and visual effects
